about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Software Development student passionate about building systems that solve real problems. I specialize in backend development with Java and relational databases - I write SQL by hand, without ORMs, because I believe understanding the fundamentals matters. I'm looking for my first professional experience where I can contribute from day one and keep growing with a team.
